units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:3">Targ. Esth. VIII, 3</cite> <he>ופַיְיסַת ליה</he> (h. text <he>ותתחנן</he>).

<cite ref="Chullin 95a:1">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite> top <he>אי הוות פַּיְיסַת מינאי וכ׳</he> if thou hadst asked my pardon (made peace with me) &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 94a">Ib. 94ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>פַּיְּיסֵיה למבורין</he> secure the good will of our ferryman (make him a present); <he>פייסיה ואיקפד</he> he offered him a present, and he (the ferryman) became angry.

<cite ref="Yoma 87a:16">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> <he>איזיל אנא לפַיּוּסֵי ליה</he> I will go and make peace with him. Y. Snh. XI, 30ᶜ top; Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ top <he>פייסיה עלי</he> make him (the idol) favorably disposed towards me.
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:16">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ומְפַיַּיסְנָא ליה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ומְפַיְּיסִינָן</he>) and I persuade him (the pupil), until he comes and reads.

<cite ref="Megillah 12a:8">Meg. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>דבני מאתיה … מפייס להו</he> for, as to the residents of his own place, he can win their favor, whenever he wants; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְפַיַּיס</he>; f. <he>מְפַיְּיסָא</he>; pl. <he>מְפַיְּיסִין</he>; <he>מְפַיְּיסָן</he>. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ bot. <he>ישכח אפין מפייסן</he> (not <he>מפייסא</he>) he may find a friendly face (a well-disposed judge).
